issuer: Spine Oncology Study Group (Fisher CG et al.)
system: Spinal Instability Neoplastic Score (SINS): six scored components summed to 0 to 18, banded as stable, indeterminate (possibly impending) instability or unstable

summary.text: Six components (location, pain, bone lesion quality, alignment, vertebral body collapse, posterolateral involvement) are scored and summed to give 0 to 18 for a neoplastic spinal lesion.

locator.section: Scoring paragraph after Table 7: sum of 6 components, 0 to 18, bands and surgical consultation (journal E1224)

summary.text: Bands: 0 to 6 stability; 7 to 12 indeterminate (possibly impending) instability; 13 to 18 instability. Scores of 7 to 18 warrant surgical consultation.

locator.section: Scoring paragraph after Table 7: sum of 6 components, 0 to 18, bands and surgical consultation (journal E1224)

summary.text: The authors stress SINS is one component of the work-up. Surgery is indicated regardless of score with neurological deficit or high-grade cord compression; modifying factors it omits must also be weighed.

locator.section: Discussion (journal E1228-E1229)

summary.text: Each lesion or region is scored separately; scores are not summed across lesions. The authors call for further validation and reliability testing of the score.

locator.section: Discussion and Conclusion (journal E1228-E1229)

summary.text: NICE NG234 (2023) says to consider a validated spinal stability scoring system such as SINS alongside clinical assessment, and to use scoring only within a full clinical assessment. It gives no SINS score thresholds.

locator.section: 1.9 Tools for assessing spinal stability and prognosis, recommendations 1.9.1 and 1.9.3

summary.text: NG234 also says to consider multiplanar viewing or 3-plane reconstruction of recent or new CT in spinal metastases or MSCC to assess spinal stability and plan vertebroplasty, kyphoplasty or spinal surgery.

locator.section: 1.5 Imaging investigations, recommendation 1.5.10

definitions.text: Spine location: junctional (occiput to C2, C7 to T2, T11 to L1, L5 to S1) 3; mobile (C3 to C6, L2 to L4) 2; semi-rigid (T3 to T10) 1; rigid (S2 to S5) 0.

locator.section: Table 2: SINS component score for spine location

definitions.text: Pain: pain with movement, upright posture or loading of the spine, and/or relieved by recumbency, 3; occasional pain that is not mechanical 1; pain-free lesion 0.

locator.section: Table 3 and Mechanical Pain text (journal E1224)

definitions.text: Bone lesion quality: lytic 2; mixed lytic/blastic 1; blastic 0. The authors note CT is the best modality for defining this.

locator.section: Table 4 and Bone Lesion Quality text (journal E1224)

definitions.text: Radiographic alignment of the motion segments affected by tumour: subluxation or translation 4; de novo kyphosis or scoliosis 2; normal 0. De novo deformity needs prior imaging or upright versus supine comparison.

locator.section: Table 5 and Spinal Alignment text (journal E1224)

definitions.text: Vertebral body collapse: more than 50% collapse 3; less than 50% collapse 2; no collapse but more than 50% of the body involved 1; none of these 0.

locator.section: Table 6 and Vertebral Body Collapse text (journal E1224)

definitions.text: Posterolateral involvement (facet, pedicle or costovertebral joint fracture or replacement by tumour): bilateral 3; unilateral 1; none 0.

locator.section: Table 7 and Posterolateral Involvement text (journal E1224-E1225)

definitions.text: Total SINS is the sum of the six component scores; the text gives a range of 0 to 18.

locator.section: Scoring paragraph after Table 7: sum of 6 components, 0 to 18, bands and surgical consultation (journal E1224)

definitions.text: Authors' working definition: loss of spinal integrity from a neoplastic process, associated with movement-related pain, symptomatic or progressive deformity and/or neural compromise under physiologic loads.

pitfalls.text: At a total of 14 the paper is inconsistent: the band text labels 13 to 18 instability and case 2 (14) is unstable, but case 1 (also 14) is read as indeterminate instability. Both 14s sit in the 13 to 18 band; this pack follows the band text.

locator.section: Scoring paragraph versus Case 1 and Case 2 (PDF p4-p5)

pitfalls.text: The scoring paragraph gives a minimum of 0; the Discussion says a minimum of 2. Component tables allow 0 for every component, so 0 is possible.

locator.section: Discussion: 'minimum score of 2 and a maximum score of 18' (journal E1228)

pitfalls.text: Not summed across lesions: each lesion or region is scored separately. The score gives no global spinal score and does not predict interaction between multiple lesions.

locator.section: Discussion (journal E1228)

pitfalls.text: Not a decision rule on its own. With neurological deficit or high-grade cord compression surgery is indicated regardless of score; histology, prognosis, health, neurology and patient choice also bear on treatment.

locator.section: Discussion and Conclusion (journal E1228-E1229)

pitfalls.text: Not scored: contiguous multilevel and noncontiguous disease, prior laminectomy or surgery, prior radiation, diffuse bony involvement or poor bone quality, body weight and activity level. The authors say these are qualifiers.

locator.section: Discussion (journal E1228)

pitfalls.text: Vertebral body collapse of exactly 50% is not defined (more than 50% scores 3, less than 50% scores 2). Table 6 scores 'none of the above' as 0 while the text scores 0 only for no body involvement, so involvement of 50% or less without collapse is not explicitly scored.

locator.section: Table 6 (journal E1224)

pitfalls.text: De novo deformity needs knowledge of prior imaging or upright versus supine radiographs; alignment is judged between the motion segments affected by tumour.

locator.section: Table 5 and Spinal Alignment text (journal E1224)

pitfalls.text: Rigid segments are S2 to S5 in Table 2 but S2 to S4 in its footnote.

locator.section: Table 2: SINS component score for spine location

pitfalls.text: Authors describe content validity from a Delphi consensus and say further validation and reliability testing are needed.

locator.section: Conclusion (journal E1229)

pitfalls.text: NG234 recommends SINS only as a 'consider' option alongside clinical assessment and attaches no action to a score band. Its surgery recommendations are also 'consider' options within a multidisciplinary treatment plan (1.11.1, 1.11.7), unlike the paper's 'indicated regardless of score'. The 7 to 18 surgical consultation line is the paper's, not NICE's.

locator.section: 1.9 Tools for assessing spinal stability and prognosis, recommendations 1.9.1 and 1.9.3

pitfalls.text: The Bone Lesion Quality text says blastic lesions score 1 and lytic 2 with no mixed category; Tables 4 and 8 give blastic 0, mixed 1, lytic 2. The pack follows the tables.

locator.section: Bone Lesion Quality text versus Table 4 (journal E1224)

pitfalls.text: SINS totals are whole numbers, but the schema has no integer constraint on the input, so a fractional total such as 6.5 would band into 7 to 12. Dictate and read only whole totals.
